reuse.why: Puts the rule in the existing getExpectedAmount helper and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold from shared/rules for the matching tolerance.

duplication.why: The tolerance arithmetic exists once, but each server site keeps its own null/op dispatch and schedule-template adds a second op check before calling the helper.

placement.why: The rule sits in shared/schedules.ts beside the range rule; the extra op condition in schedule-template.ts keeps part of the dispatch at a call site.

scope.why: Only the helper, its callers and a test change.

maintainability.why: An optional untyped op parameter is threaded through call sites (getScheduledAmount gains it after inverse, forcing a positional false), and the client callers of getScheduledAmount (Balance.tsx, SchedulesTable.tsx, mobile lists) were not updated, so they still plan approximate amounts at the exact value.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All touched sites call getExpectedAmount/getScheduledAmount; no site recomputes the tolerance.

one_place.where: The rule is defined once in getExpectedAmount, but it only applies when the caller passes op; desktop-client getScheduledAmount callers (accounts/Balance.tsx, schedules/SchedulesTable.tsx, mobile schedules) and the isbetween/isapprox check in budget/schedule-template.ts decide separately.
